name: OPS-SAT benchmark
description: A benchmark focused on detecting anomalies in satellite telemetry streams, supplying telemetry datasets and evaluation criteria for onboard anomaly detection.
reputation: Niche but respected within the space-systems research community and among ESA-affiliated projects for onboard anomaly-detection research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark using small, domain-specific telemetry streams with significant class imbalance and distribution-shift risk; results sensitive to preprocessing and potential contamination if telemetry logs overlap with training data.
